litmus_colour_confusion.feedback: Acids turn blue litmus red; bases turn red litmus blue.
litmus_colour_confusion.calm_prompt: Remember: acid = red litmus; base = blue litmus.

neutralisation_products_error.feedback: Neutralisation always produces salt and water: acid + base → salt + H₂O.
neutralisation_products_error.calm_prompt: Both H⁺ and OH⁻ combine to form water.

dilution_order_wrong.feedback: When diluting acid, add acid slowly to water with stirring — never water to acid.
dilution_order_wrong.calm_prompt: Add A to W — Acid to Water.

ph_scale_reversed.feedback: Lower pH means more acidic; higher pH means more basic. pH 7 is neutral.

indicator_in_acid_base_confusion.feedback: Phenolphthalein is colourless in acid and pink in base; methyl orange is red in acid, yellow in base.
indicator_in_acid_base_confusion.calm_prompt: Check Table 2.1 colours for each indicator.
